# `rebuildmeta`

Rebuild metadata folder tables from an existing AnnData file

- Wrapper: [`job_rebuild_metadata.sh`](https://github.com/dr-michael-haley/imcanalysis/blob/main/SLURM_scripts/job_rebuild_metadata.sh)
- Conda environment: `sbt-analysis`
- Python module: `SpatialBiologyToolkit.scripts.rebuild_metadata`

## Inputs

- general.anndata_path (or rebuild_metadata.input_adata_path override)

## Outputs

- general.metadata_folder/{metadata.csv,dictionary.csv,panel.csv}
- outputs/<execution_id>_Metadata_Rebuild/ stage report

## Configuration

- general, rebuild_metadata, logging

## Run

From the dataset directory containing `config.yaml`:

```bash
pl rebuildmeta
```
